title: Shark holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sharkBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5cc8e8'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#3fa8cf'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d8f3fa'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='finShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4bb8dc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2f8fb5'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='heartGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7aa8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e3336a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M14 46 C8 34 4 30 2 28 C10 32 16 38 20 44 L20 56 C16 62 10 68 2 72 C4 70 8 66 14 54 Z' fill='url(#finShade)'/>

  <!-- big shark body -->
  <path d='M12 50 C18 32 40 24 62 26 C80 28 92 38 94 50 C92 62 80 72 62 74 C40 76 18 68 12 50 Z' fill='url(#sharkBody)'/>

  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <path d='M30 64 C42 70 58 70 72 64 C62 71 44 71 30 64 Z' fill='#eefbff'/>

  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M40 27 C44 14 54 8 58 10 C56 18 56 24 58 27 Z' fill='url(#finShade)'/>

  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M36 64 C34 76 40 84 48 86 C46 78 46 70 48 64 Z' fill='url(#finShade)'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='42' r='6' fill='#f7fdff'/>
  <circle cx='77.5' cy='42' r='3.2' fill='#1d5f7a'/>
  <circle cx='78.5' cy='40.6' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- gills -->
  <path d='M60 40 C62 44 62 50 60 54' stroke='#2f8fb5' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 40 C68 44 68 50 66 54' stroke='#2f8fb5' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M78 56 C84 56 90 53 93 50' stroke='#2b7f9c' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <path d='M80 56 l2 3 l2 -3 l2 3 l2 -3' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- heart held by fin -->
  <g transform='translate(44,52)'>
    <path d='M0 18 C-16 6 -14 -6 -7 -6 C-3 -6 0 -2 0 1 C0 -2 3 -6 7 -6 C14 -6 16 6 0 18 Z' fill='url(#heartGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='-4' cy='0' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#ffc4d8' opacity='0.85'/>
  </g>

  <!-- fin tip cradling heart -->
  <path d='M30 58 C34 56 38 56 40 58 C38 62 34 63 30 62 Z' fill='url(#finShade)'/>
</svg>
